title: Train a Tiny Radiance Field
summary: Build coordinate features, render ordered samples, differentiate image error and train a shared bounded field.

stages.title: Represent scene coordinates
stages.description: Build the fixed Fourier-feature basis; the integration consumes supplied features in one shared scene convention.

stages.title: Render ordered ray samples
stages.description: Track opacity, exclusive transmittance and background before interpreting pixel error.

stages.title: Differentiate occlusion and color
stages.description: Include downstream samples and background in the density gradient.

stages.title: Train and evaluate the shared field
stages.description: Use the explicit affine field and clipped SGD recipe with a separate held-out ray batch.
